description: This Java class 'LayoutEvents' contains various static methods for handling content layout operations within an Apache OFBiz-based content management system. It manages tasks such as creating and updating layout images, replacing sub-content, cloning layouts, creating and updating sub-content, and copying content IDs to a clipboard-like structure. The class interacts with OFBiz components such as Delegator, LocalDispatcher, and ContentManagementWorker, and utilizes mini-language processors, entity queries, and service calls to perform content operations.

classes.name: LayoutEvents
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to handle content layout and management tasks in OFBiz.

methods.name: createLayoutImage
methods.description: Handles uploading and persisting a new layout image, including processing image data, updating content records, and managing image data resources.

methods.name: updateLayoutImage
methods.description: Updates an existing layout image with new image data and metadata.

methods.name: replaceSubContent
methods.description: Replaces a sub-content element linked to a data resource, managing content associations.

methods.name: cloneLayout
methods.description: Clones an existing layout, including copying content and data resources, and re-establishing content associations.

methods.name: createLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Creates new sub-content under a specified parent content, establishing necessary associations.

methods.name: updateLayoutSubContent
methods.description: Updates the sub-content and data resource information linked to a layout.

methods.name: copyToClip
methods.description: Copies content entity identifiers and primary key attributes into a temporary clip for reuse.
